prd_section: 3.1 持仓模式：单向／双向，切换需要平掉当前存在的仓位

endpoints.mutation: POST /fapi/v3/positionSide/dual; dualSidePosition string true/false, no symbol

contract_checks: Account-wide: official document states EVERY symbol for GET and POST
GET response dualSidePosition must be JSON boolean; write enum explicitly maps hedge to string true and one-way to string false
Strict full-account positionAmt Decimal validation and mode/position-side coherence; tiny positions and other symbols block
Active orders use existing strict mapper, all symbols included; incompatible position sides fail read
Official -4059 already set, -4067 open orders, -4068 positions map to localized safe failure reasons and code
Exact signed body with shared fresh nonce, EIP712 chain 1666, current connected wallet as both user and signer
POST acknowledgement does not prove final mode; new signed GET determines observed result and time
reference_boundary: Reference informs explicit mode, context validity and mutation boundaries; its Hip3 protocol does not define Aster positionSide/dual.
implementation_boundaries: No automatic private reads on entry; three explicitly initiated signatures for read
30-second validity begins at first mode response including remaining signatures and reads
Preflight responses are not an atomic exchange lock; external changes and eligibility remain Aster validation
No automatic close, cancel, margin or asset-mode change
All three setting types share activity, unresolved-result blocking and epoch invalidation
Unknown write persists across routes; GET-only verification never repeats POST
Submission marks account/risk/ADL/orders snapshots historical without generating financial values
Identity changes discard old results and block subsequent old signatures; no extra wallet, agent or API key
Independent settings page, not yet integrated into live order-entry or quick orders
